name: Power of Conviction
body:
Rather than draw the power for your spells and class abilities from years of experience and good judgement, your power is inspired by your compelling conviction.

Prerequisite(s): Access to blessings or inquisitions.

Benefit(s): You use your Charisma modifier for spellcasting for the purposes of determining what level spells you can cast, the number of bonus spells accrued, and the Difficulty Class for the saving throws against your spells. You also use your Charisma modifier to determine the save DCs for your blessing and inquisition abilities (or domain abilities if you chose a domain rather than an inquisition).

Normal: Warpriests and inquisitors use their Wisdom modifier for their spell-casting, blessings, and inquisition/domain abilities.
